params.body:
A page that shows what the pipeline is doing now, refreshed every five seconds from `/live` (pipeline #253, merged).

- Counters: in during the last hour, in and read over 24 hours, new trend drafts over 24 hours, and a bar per minute for the last hour.
- A framed line when a source fails several times in a row; absent when all collect.
- Which regions the last hour is about.
- Three streams side by side: In (platform, source, region), Read (read or set aside, with relevance), Out (new trend draft, merged into another, post published). New rows slide in at the top and glow in their stream's colour; reduced motion turns that off.
- Each poll asks from 15 seconds before the previous answer, so nothing between two polls is lost; rows are deduplicated by id.
- Route `/live`, in the menu between Patterns and Data.
- `e2e/live.spec.js`; 29 e2e pass, build ok, lint ratchet at its ceiling.
params.title: Live: what the pipeline is doing now
